game_concept: A survival strategy set in Frost Peaks – Crevasse Bridge, a rope bridge over a crevasse: the ice axe ranger must handle falling rocks while practicing strings & dictionaries. Core idea – Phrase Slicer: Slice strings to cut messages into exactly the needed pieces.
theme: Frost Peaks – Crevasse Bridge: a rope bridge over a crevasse
core_gameplay_loop: In Crevasse Bridge, repeat each round: Slice strings to cut messages into exactly the needed pieces. Each round, falling rocks strike the rope bridge, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the phrase_ok value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Protect the rope bridge from falling rocks in Crevasse Bridge: keep the phrase_ok meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 54-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: phrase_ok drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 54-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 8 – Strings & Dictionaries | Level 9 (extended tier): Phrase Slicer
assets_style: towering pixel-art mountains: glaciers, jagged ice ridges, crisp white and cyan with deep blue shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Phrase Slicer' (Week 8 slot 2), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Crevasse Bridge'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Frost Peaks
region.mood: thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how phrase_ok changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against falling rocks in Crevasse Bridge.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 54 seconds while phrase_ok > 0.
